Stacking thick tomahawk steaks on a tall spit, marinating the meat deep and roasting it until the outside chars and the inside stays juicy for a wild doner tower!🥩🔥
Shaving tomahawk steak doner into bread, adding simple salad and sauce, and serving a heavy village style meat wrap that feels like street food from the mountains!🌯⛰️
